# Office HVAC Multi-mode Energy-Saving Control

- **Difficulty:** Medium (medium)

## Requirements

Control an office-building supply fan and generate a temperature-setpoint adjustment from occupancy, operating mode and the energy-saving selection.

1. Valid HVAC_MODE_SELECTOR values are 0 (Auto), 1 (Comfort), 2 (Economy) and 3 (Night).
2. Start a 30-second delay only when occupancy is detected and Night mode is not selected. SUPPLY_FAN_RUN becomes TRUE only after these conditions remain satisfied for 30 seconds. Immediately stop the fan and reset timing if occupancy is lost or Night mode is selected. Wait the full 30 seconds again when the conditions recover.
3. Auto mode: use a 0°C adjustment when occupied. When unoccupied, use +3°C in energy-saving mode or +2°C in standard mode.
4. Comfort mode: use 0°C when occupied or +1°C when unoccupied. Economy mode: use 0°C when occupied or +4°C when unoccupied.
5. Night mode: use +4°C regardless of occupancy. The energy-saving selection affects only Auto mode.
6. Keep TEMP_SETPOINT_ADJUST within ±4°C. Initialize outputs to OFF and zero at power-up; update them from current inputs when normal calculation begins.
7. The start delay controls only the BOOL fan enable; no continuous speed ramp is required.

## Interface Definition

| Direction | Variable/Field | Data Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Input | `OCCUPANCY_DETECTED` | `BOOL` | Occupancy-detection result derived from the CO₂ sensor. |
| Input | `ENERGY_SAVING_MODE` | `BOOL` | TRUE selects energy saving; FALSE selects standard operation; affects Auto mode only. |
| Input | `HVAC_MODE_SELECTOR` | `INT` | 0 Auto, 1 Comfort, 2 Economy, 3 Night; callers supply a valid value. |
| Output | `SUPPLY_FAN_RUN` | `BOOL` | Supply-fan run enable. |
| Output | `TEMP_SETPOINT_ADJUST` | `INT` | Temperature-setpoint adjustment in °C. |

(* -------------------------------------------------------------
   Office HVAC Multi‑mode Energy‑Saving Control
   -------------------------------------------------------------
   Inputs
     OCCUPANCY_DETECTED   – TRUE when occupancy is detected
     ENERGY_SAVING_MODE   – TRUE → energy‑saving, FALSE → standard
     HVAC_MODE_SELECTOR   – 0 = Auto, 1 = Comfort, 2 = Economy, 3 = Night
   Outputs
     SUPPLY_FAN_RUN       – Supply‑fan run enable (BOOL)
     TEMP_SETPOINT_ADJUST – Temperature‑setpoint adjustment in °C (INT)
   -------------------------------------------------------------
   Behaviour
     • 30 s on‑delay for the fan when occupied and NOT in Night mode.
       The fan is stopped immediately and the timer is reset when
       occupancy is lost or Night mode is entered.
     • Temperature‑setpoint adjustment follows the table:
       Mode   | Occupied | Unoccupied (standard) | Unoccupied (energy‑saving)
       -------|----------|-----------------------|----------------------------
       Auto   |   0 °C   |        +2 °C          |            +3 °C
       Comfort|   0 °C   |        +1 °C          |            +1 °C
       Economy|   0 °C   |        +4 °C          |            +4 °C
       Night  |   +4 °C  |        +4 °C          |            +4 °C
       (Energy‑saving flag influences only Auto mode.)
     • Outputs are initialised to OFF / 0 at power‑up and are updated
       every scan from the current inputs.
   ------------------------------------------------------------- *)

PROGRAM HVAC_Control
   VAR_INPUT
      OCCUPANCY_DETECTED   : BOOL;
      ENERGY_SAVING_MODE   : BOOL;
      HVAC_MODE_SELECTOR   : INT;
   END_VAR

   VAR_OUTPUT
      SUPPLY_FAN_RUN       : BOOL := FALSE;   (* OFF at power‑up *)
      TEMP_SETPOINT_ADJUST : INT  := 0;       (* zero at power‑up *)
   END_VAR

   VAR
      FanTimer      : TON;                    (* 30‑second on‑delay *)
      FanStartCond  : BOOL;                   (* condition to start the timer *)
   END_VAR

   (* ---------------------------------------------------------
      Fan start condition: occupied AND NOT Night mode
      --------------------------------------------------------- *)
   FanStartCond := OCCUPANCY_DETECTED AND (HVAC_MODE_SELECTOR <> 3);

   (* ---------------------------------------------------------
      30‑second ON‑delay timer
      The timer resets automatically when FanStartCond becomes FALSE,
      fulfilling the “reset timing if occupancy is lost or Night mode
      is selected” requirement.
      --------------------------------------------------------- *)
   FanTimer(IN := FanStartCond, PT := T#30s);
   SUPPLY_FAN_RUN := FanTimer.Q;

   (* ---------------------------------------------------------
      Temperature‑setpoint adjustment according to mode,
      occupancy and energy‑saving selection.
      --------------------------------------------------------- *)
   CASE HVAC_MODE_SELECTOR OF
      0 : (* Auto *)
         IF OCCUPANCY_DETECTED THEN
            TEMP_SETPOINT_ADJUST := 0;
         ELSE
            IF ENERGY_SAVING_MODE THEN
               TEMP_SETPOINT_ADJUST := 3;   (* +3 °C when energy‑saving *)
            ELSE
               TEMP_SETPOINT_ADJUST := 2;   (* +2 °C in standard mode *)
            END_IF;
         END_IF;

      1 : (* Comfort *)
         IF OCCUPANCY_DETECTED THEN
            TEMP_SETPOINT_ADJUST := 0;
         ELSE
            TEMP_SETPOINT_ADJUST := 1;
         END_IF;

      2 : (* Economy *)
         IF OCCUPANCY_DETECTED THEN
            TEMP_SETPOINT_ADJUST := 0;
         ELSE
            TEMP_SETPOINT_ADJUST := 4;
         END_IF;

      3 : (* Night *)
         TEMP_SETPOINT_ADJUST := 4;

   END_CASE;

END_PROGRAM
